turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My garden is drowning in cucumbers. Can I pickle them without canning equipment?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, fridge pickles are easy. You just need jars, vinegar, water, salt, a little sugar and some dill.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Equal parts vinegar and water, with about a tablespoon of salt and a teaspoon of sugar per cup of liquid.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Different question. I walk to work with my laptop and my current bag is wrecking my shoulder. Help me pick a new one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I've got a long list here and I'll want your verdict once I've read the last one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A leather messenger bag looks really smart for meetings, but it's still one strap on one shoulder.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a waterproof rolltop backpack, very sturdy, but it looks a bit like I'm off hiking.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a slim office backpack with a padded laptop sleeve and a luggage strap, kind of middle of the road.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, um, that's everything, I think. Your thoughts?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Two straps beat one for your shoulder, so it's really the rolltop or the slim backpack. How wet is your walk? Lots of rain, go rolltop. Mostly dry, the office one will look better at meetings.
